method: Authored solid colors or un-clipped browser-painted gradient; paired full-page text-hidden composited background screenshots; every pixel inside text-node line rectangles; deterministic direct calls to the live renderer at stated seconds, matching existing canvas transform and DOM layout. Sampling is conservative over line rectangles, not a guarantee over all time/pointers.
